svg.aria-label: AgentEngine: what it is made of
svg.title: AgentEngine: what it is made of
svg.text: AgentEngine: what it is made of
stops a cut-off call, sums up a big result
the tools the model is offered
the tools the agent wrote itself
what the user types, the model never sees
the system prompt, running and writing skills
a part: its role, then its type
a port: a way in or out

text.tspan: the engine builds its parts once, hands each what it needs, and passes what it is asked on to the part that does it.
